title: Income Tax | ITAT Visakhapatnam Quashes Section 271AAB Penalty for Defective Section 274 Notice
summary: ITAT Visakhapatnam quashes 271AAB penalty as section 274 notice failed to specify the applicable clause, vitiating penalty initiation. The post ITAT Visakhapatnam Quashes Section 271AAB Penalty for Defective Section 274 Notice appeared first on TaxGuru .
ai_summary: ITAT Visakhapatnam quashed a penalty imposed under Section 271AAB, finding the Section 274 notice to be defective. The tribunal ruled that the penalty initiation was vitiated because the notice failed to specify the applicable clause.
